question: Does the schema the working local pipeline produces restore on PostgreSQL 17, so the adapter layer can stay and only the image changes?

runs.verdict: invalid measurement: the supabase image does not give postgres DDL rights, so every statement failed

sample: function "email" already exists with same argument types
runs.verdict: the schema restores; every error is an object the supabase image seeds itself (auth, storage, vault, extensions, graphql, realtime, pgbouncer), not an incompatibility
every object lands and none is missing; the residual is a role the schema dump names but does not create, plus one --clean artefact
the graphql_public clean error is gone; the 119 role errors remain because that role is not in the source cluster's pg_roles even though the dump names it

notYetMeasured: Why the dump names privacy_workflow_owner while that role is absent from the source cluster's pg_roles. With all 260 objects present and nothing missing, this affects policy ownership only, not the schema.
A run that reports restored=true, which needs the role reference resolved rather than worked around.
blockedBy: GitHub Actions runner DNS failures (archive.ubuntu.com, security.ubuntu.com) aborted six nightly dispatches on 2026-11-11 at 'Install Chromium'. The workflow now retries that step four times and the probe runs before the lanes, so the measurement no longer depends on the browser lane.
conclusion: The baseline-restore path is viable: the working schema lands on PG17 with 260 of 260 objects and none missing, and no version-incompatibility error has been observed. The switch does not need the ~24 migrations the adapters replace to be rewritten. The open item is a single role reference in the dump, not the schema.
